title: NumberIQ Starter Puzzles
description: 20 beginner, 20 intermediate and 10 advanced sample puzzles. Every shortest solution has 4-6 moves. Difficulty labels are provisional until playtested.

formatNotes.candidateGeneration: Apply each listed operation to the current number. Keep only integer results within inclusive minNumber/maxNumber bounds. Exclude unchanged values and any number already in the current ladder. Preserve operations array order.
formatNotes.duplicateCandidates: Show one candidate per result number. If several operations produce that number, retain all matching operation ids for its label; selecting the result counts as one turn.
formatNotes.operationTypes: add, subtract, multiply and divide use the positive integer operand. divide is legal only with zero remainder. reverseDigits ignores operand (stored as 0).
formatNotes.digitReversal: Reverse decimal digits, then discard leading zeroes: 23 becomes 32; 40 becomes 4. One-digit numbers and palindromes reverse to themselves and are excluded as no-op moves.
formatNotes.turnLimit: maxTurns 0 means no hard turn limit. optimalTurns is the verified shortest solution length, not a limit on player moves.
formatNotes.undo: Undo removes the last ladder number and restores the preceding state. Removed numbers become selectable again. Elapsed time continues.
formatNotes.completion: Complete immediately on reaching targetNumber. Do not generate further moves. If there are no legal candidates before reaching the target, allow Undo or Retry.
formatNotes.timer: Start timing on START, stop when the target is reached. Retry resets the current ladder and timer.
formatNotes.solution: optimalPath includes start and target. optimalOperationIds[i] transforms optimalPath[i] into optimalPath[i+1]. This is one shortest solution; other equally short solutions are valid.
formatNotes.scoring: Fewer turns rank first; elapsed time breaks ties. Turns equal current ladder length minus one. Undo rewinds turns, but not elapsed time.
formatNotes.playerState: Keep DONE flags, selected puzzle and player results outside this read-only puzzle pack. Use packId plus puzzle id as the stable key.
formatNotes.compatibility: Plain objects and arrays with explicit primitive fields. Requires a NumberIQ loader; this is not a drop-in replacement for the WordIQ puzzle format.
